text:
Marie Chen: Heads up — NorthStar portal rejected PO 987654321 for the ACME deal. Error says signer affinity mismatch. This is blocking procurement; partner is asking for a valid signer on their portal now.

AJ Patel: Ugh. Can you paste the exact portal error? Need to know whether it's signer id or billing entity mismatch.

Marie Chen: Error text from portal: "PO rejected: signer does not match merchant alias affiliation (expected alias_id=NS-ALIAS-77, found alias_id=RW-DEV-2)"

Samir K: This is the classic marketplace merchant alias/signatory affinity rule. NorthStar enforces signer-to-merchant mapping for PO acceptance. I've opened support case NS-4421 with their portal team.

Laura Gomez: We need this unblocked today — finance needs PO acknowledged before we can invoice. Can we do a short-term workaround? @Samir K any idea? :pray:

Priya Nair: From legal: if the signer is different we need an attestation or amendment linking the billing entity to the signer on file. We can draft a 1‑page attestation (sample below) but NorthStar has to accept it. Do we have the customer contact there?

Jordan Lee: DeployBot shows marketplace connector returned HTTP 422 and EDI ack failure, and downstream billing pipeline flagged duplicate vendor mapping. Log excerpt: `ERR: partner.edi.acceptance=422|reason=signer_affinity`

Marie Chen: Short-term workaround suggested by eng: add an alternate signer header in the PO XML so the partner portal picks up `SignerAlias` field. Example snippet: ```<PO><Header><SignerAlias>NS-ALIAS-77</SignerAlias><BillingEntity>EIN:12-3456789</BillingEntity></Header>...</PO>``` We can re-submit via the gateway.

AJ Patel: Is that allowed by NorthStar? Might be swallowed by their validation. If it bypasses validation we risk downstream reconciliation mismatches.

Samir K: I'm on a call with NorthStar PM in 20m. Plan: 1) propose they accept signer alias header as temporary accepted field, 2) legal sends attestation, 3) Partnerships coordinates portal config change. I've asked for a service window and an ETA by EOD.

Laura Gomez: I'll ping the NorthStar AE and push for approval from their procurement. @Priya Nair I'll loop you into their procurement thread.

Priya Nair: Thanks. I'll prepare the attestation template now and share for quick sign by the customer's authorized signer. Send over the signer's name and email.

Jordan Lee: Pushed a patch to marketplace-connector branch `hotfix/northstar-signer` to include optional `SignerAlias` header; test infra passed for sandbox. DeployBot: Deployed `hotfix/northstar-signer` to staging at 2026-03-21T14:05Z.

Samir K: Great. Partnerships will own the comms. If NorthStar confirms acceptance, we'll flip the gateway to include the alias for this account only. Deadline: EOD today. If not resolved, we'll escalate to channel partner ops.

Marie Chen: Copy. I'll coordinate finance and customer for the attestation signoff. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

DeployBot: Incident note appended to case NS-4421. Link: https://northstar.support/cases/NS-4421 (internal tracker: PART-7932)
